notes.title: Ultimate Idle Racing GO update is OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
Hi Folks, are you ready for the NEW Ultimate Idle Racing GO update? It's OUT NOW!

[b]1. [/b]Discover new in-game animations and UI changes.
[b]2. [/b]Have fun with totally new daily challenges with extra rewards for each completed task and for completing several tasks in a row as well as for completing a minimum of 4 tasks daily for 5 days a week.
[b]3,[/b] Enjoy the game completing weekly challenges,
[b]4.[/b] Collect 3 new Mythical rare cards to level up to 10 levels.
[b]5.[/b] Get most of CPU which affects the number of prizes you can win in tournaments - at the maximum level the player receives: 5 more blueprints for the garage, 4 times more coin and diamond collector, 10 cash cases.
[b]6. [/b]Make sure you upgrade the Transmission which has an influence on the player's performance multiplier during the taping. The maximum level doubles the tap multipliers.
[b]7.[/b] Discover the KERS which affects the maximum speed of evading opponents. After reaching the maximum level, the player can evade opponents twice as fast
Try to collect some of the 15 sets of cards folded from all cards falling out of the afterburner packs.

– Set to increase the performance of the player's car - it can be improved indefinitely
– Set to raise player's earnings in offline mode - also improved indefinitely
– Set to increase earnings for defeating opponents - endless upgrade level 
– Set reducing the cost of car parts - up to level 20 which translates to 50% of the price of the part
– Set that reduces the purchase price and upgrade of skills - also to a maximum of 20 levels at which the discount is 50%
– Set increasing the ascendant currency multiplier - a maximum of 20 levels, a maximum of 200% more ascending currency
– Set that increases the chance of a van with extra money appearing - 25 levels for 50% more chance
– Set that increases the money multiplier for defeating a van with extra money - it can be improved indefinitely
– Set that increases the time to defeat the boss - improved indefinitely
– Set reducing the cooldown of all active skills - 25 levels to maximum cooldown cutting by 50%
Guild Currency Income Set - Can be upgraded indefinitely
– Set reducing the cost of firing crew members - a maximum of 20 levels reducing the cost by 50%
– Set reducing the cost of hiring crew members - also 20 levels to a maximum discount of 50%
– Set reducing the cost of upgrading crew members - 20 levels to a maximum of 50%

Update the game and have endless fun!

notes.title: T-Bull Announcements [UPDATE 2.9 SERVER PROBLEM 3/06/2019]
notes.notes: Hello all, here's something that pertains to the latest Idle Racing GO update! We are sorry for the delay in solving server problems and really count on your understanding and support! We launched today the new server and we will add major functions step by step. All old guilds and tournaments will be deleted shortly.

notes.title: T-Bull Announcements [UPDATE AVAILABLE 2/21/2019]
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

thanks once again for your feedback on Idle Racing GO! Much appreciated! It will help us to improve the game. As you see, we update the game regularly to add new features and collect valuable feedback.

Here's what's new:
– Steam achievements added to the game
– Steam Friends invites available,
– new garage design, 
– totally new car tiers system,
– 6 new cars added to the game,
– New server replacement (every guild and tournaments have been deleted),
– New guilds thresholds, shop prices, creating guild is now free for 30 days
– Free blueprints pack available
– Bug with date parsing 
– Prefs storing fixed

Thanks for joining the Early Access stage and playing Idle Racing GO!

notes.title: T-Bull Announcement [UPDATE 1.0v1]
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

your feedback is highly appreciated! It will help us to improve Idle Racing GO and provide you with even better gaming experience! We do our best to update the game as often as possible to add new features and collect valuable feedback. 

Here's what's new:
- Keyboard arrows for swiping added (Press the arrow keys to swipe left and right. Make sure, you can always use the mouse control. Then you can move the mouse pointer and simply swipe left and right.)
- Upgrade button moved to the main screen,
- Exit Game button fixed (by clicking ESC and from the setting window)
- Garage textures fixed,
- Tutorial's bug after losing the Boss Race fixed,
- Steam overlay on ' f ' on the keyboard fixed,
- Steam Friends leaderboard added,
- Online Tournaments redesigned and fixed, 
- Blueprints Distribution after swiping added,
-New screen on resolution pop-up added,
- Upgrade tab fixed (Clicking «Upgrade» tab brings you Car Parts as the first option)
- Mouse scrolling speed increased,
- Wrong price on creating gang fixed,
- Validating system for player's nickname added

Moreover, we are planning to add Steam Achievements in the next update soon!

Thanks for joining the Early Access stage and playing Idle Racing GO!
